context: Request: the first traditional, non-SPAC IPO the firm took public (for a pitch bio), with the offering documents and a document showing the deal closed. Rubric: 1037-00001 (Solstice Biomedical Devices, closed March 2023), an offering document and a closing deliverable from it, plus a precision criterion. A later IPO (1010-00002, Arbor Health, February 2024) and an earlier SPAC IPO (1002-00001) are in the store.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob; the review flags the cap.

stages.stage: Search file names for a document type
stages.note: declared: List files in the document store (attempt 2). A glob of the matters folder (nothing) and six file-name globs for offering-document and closing words; two return nothing.

stages.stage: Search file names for a document type
stages.note: declared: List files in the document store (attempt 3). A script that lists all matter folders and every file whose name has offering-document words. The review flags that candidates were ranked by matter number, unopened.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: declared: Screen candidate matters by reading documents. Globs all files of eight candidate matters, including one with an executed underwriting agreement and closing certificates.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads offering, closing and engagement documents of three of the eight (one guessed path fails). The review names the listed-but-unread matter with closing certificates as possibly earlier or later than the one picked.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script for offering and closing phrases times out; two range scans follow, viewed in truncated form.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: File-backed range scans for completed-offering phrases; only per-matter hit counts are printed.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: declared: Read documents picked from the file listing. Reads the openings of eight high-count hit documents from eight matters, all ruled out.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads the registration statement, underwriting agreement, memo and closing papers of the matter it picked.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Names the 2024 offering as the first traditional IPO, with its offering and closing documents and reasons for excluding earlier SPAC, withdrawn and dormant matters.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Re-reads the response and globs the chosen matter's folder; no change.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.failure_point: It listed the files of the matter it needed but read only three other candidates, and named a later offering as the first.

first_error.why: It listed the matter's files at [28]-[36] (an executed underwriting agreement and closing certificates) but never read any of them and left it out of the answer; the screening review at [49] named this matter as listed but unread and possibly earlier, and the agent ran scans and read other hits instead.
first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) [49] named the matter as listed but not read and possibly earlier.

runs.failure_point: It listed the matter it needed, then fixed its candidate set with a three-way file-name filter that dropped it, and named a later offering as the first.

first_error.stage: Search file names for a document type
first_error.why: Its own listing at [41]-[43] included the matter, but the file-name intersection it wrote to fix the candidate set dropped it, and the answer was built only from the eight matters that passed; the review named this exact risk and the agent went on to read only filtered candidates.
first_error.critic_note: (generic flag) [51] named the three-way name filter as dropping matters named differently, not the matter.

stages.note: declared: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth (attempt 2). Reads an earlier candidate's papers to rule it out and lists files of a range of early matters.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → List matter folders → Search file names for request keywords → List files in candidate matters → Scan document text with an extraction script → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run

divergence: All three runs listed the files of the matter they needed. They split at the next choice of what to read. T2 read that matter's engagement letter and closing certificate next to the later offering, compared dates and passed. T0 read three other candidates and never opened it, then answered with the later offering (under-inclusion); the screening review named the unread matter explicitly and the agent did not open it. T1 fixed its candidate set with a three-way file-name filter that dropped it (over-narrow-filter); that stage's review named the filter's risk and the agent moved on. So the critic flagged the problem in both failing runs and was ignored both times.
